title: Hearty, Soft, Chewy German Sausage Burger
description: A buttery, chewy, adventurous German dish featuring red wine jelly and infused oil, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe serves 4 and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 37512F.
Prepare a lazy Susan spinner or a large cast-iron skillet for cooking.
Remove the sausages from their casings and cook for about 5 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill by placing them directly on the heat source for about 30 seconds per side.
Spread a layer of red wine jelly on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked sausage, some caramelized onions, a few slices of bacon, and a sprinkle of chives.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
Let the burger rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
